text.tspan: Share of the working-age population who are employed. Figures refer to national estimates and may not be fully

tspan.tspan: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026)
Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where

text.tspan: data for 1980 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1975 and 1985 is shown instead.
